_about: Sky per land (WORLD_GUIDE.md): sun, ambient light, fog and weather, blended when you cross onto a land. Lands not listed use 'fallback'. sunPitch = degrees above the horizon, sunYaw = compass direction the light travels toward. skyLight / horizonLight / groundLight = ambient light from above, the sides and below. fogColor is also the colour of the sky. weather: '', 'snow' or 'rain', with weatherAmount 0 to 1.
